faq.q: Which is faster: Pershing 46 or Astondoa 40?
faq.a: The Pershing 46 is faster, with a top speed around 40+ knots, thanks to its sporty design and powerful engines. The Astondoa 40 cruises at about 25-30 knots, making the Pershing a better choice if speed and thrill are your priority.

faq.q: How many people can each boat accommodate?
faq.a: The Pershing 46 can carry up to 10 passengers, while the Astondoa 40 accommodates a maximum of 9. Both are perfect for small groups, families, or couples wanting an intimate experience on the water.

faq.q: What is the price difference between Pershing 46 and Astondoa 40?
faq.a: The Astondoa 40 has set prices starting from €749 for 2 hours up to €2,299 for 8 hours, including skipper, drinks, and VAT. The Pershing 46 is priced on request via WhatsApp, reflecting its premium sport-yacht status.

faq.q: Where do these boats depart from in Marbella?
faq.a: Both the Pershing 46 and Astondoa 40 depart from Puerto Banús, the famous marina in Marbella. This gives you immediate access to the Costa del Sol coastline and landmarks like La Concha mountain.

faq.q: What is included in the charter for both boats?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, safety equipment, Spanish IVA (21%), and complimentary drinks (water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava) plus light snacks. No hidden costs.

faq.q: Which boat is better for a party or celebration?
faq.a: The Pershing 46, with its sleek design and higher speed, adds a wow factor for celebrations. The Astondoa 40 offers a more relaxed, spacious flybridge, ideal for socialising with drinks and music. Both are excellent for parties.

faq.q: Can I visit Cala del Faro or Cabopino with either boat?
faq.a: Yes, both boats can easily reach Cala del Faro, Cabopino, and even Estepona. The Pershing 46’s speed lets you cover more distance quickly, while the Astondoa 40 offers a comfortable cruise to these spots.

faq.q: How do I book the Pershing 46 or Astondoa 40?
faq.a: For the Astondoa 40, you can book directly via our website with fixed pricing. For the Pershing 46, contact us on WhatsApp for a custom quote. Both require a deposit to secure your date.

data.body_html:
Choosing between the Pershing 46 and the Astondoa 40 for your Marbella boat charter? Both depart from Puerto Banús and offer premium experiences, but they cater to different priorities. This comparison breaks down speed, capacity, pricing, and best use cases to help you decide. Whether you crave adrenaline or relaxed cruising, we’ll match you with the right yacht.

Key Specs at a Glance

FeaturePershing 46Astondoa 40
Length14 m12.5 m
Max passengers109

Price (8h)On request€2,299
InclusionsSkipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, VATSkipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, VAT

Performance and Speed

The Pershing 46 is a sport yacht built for speed. With twin engines pushing over 40 knots, it’s perfect for thrill-seekers who want to feel the wind and reach destinations like Cala Cortés or Estepona quickly. The Astondoa 40 cruises comfortably at 25-30 knots, offering a smoother, more relaxed ride. If your priority is covering distance fast, choose the Pershing; for leisurely cruising, the Astondoa wins.

Capacity and Comfort

Both yachts are ideal for small groups. The Pershing 46 seats 10 guests in a sleek, sporty layout with a sunpad and cockpit. The Astondoa 40 accommodates 9 and features a flybridge, providing extra space for lounging and sunbathing. For families or couples, the Astondoa’s flybridge adds a social dimension. The Pershing’s design is more focused on a dynamic, close-to-water experience.

Pricing and Value

The Astondoa 40 offers transparent pricing: €749 for 2 hours to €2,299 for 8 hours, with all inclusions. The Pershing 46 is priced on request via WhatsApp, reflecting its premium status. For budget-conscious charters, the Astondoa provides excellent value. If you want a bespoke experience with a faster yacht, the Pershing is worth the investment. Explore all Marbella boat rentals for more options.

Best Use Cases

  • Pershing 46: Best for speed lovers, day trips to Cabopino, or making a statement at Puerto Banús.
  • Astondoa 40: Ideal for relaxed family outings, sunset cruises along the Golden Mile, or budget-friendly half-day rentals.

Which Should You Choose?

Your choice depends on your vibe. The Pershing 46 is the adrenaline machine – fast, flashy, and exclusive. The Astondoa 40 is the versatile, value-packed cruiser with a flybridge for socialising. Both depart from Puerto Banús and include skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks. Read more Marbella charter guides to refine your decision.

Frequently asked questions

Which is faster: Pershing 46 or Astondoa 40?

The Pershing 46 is faster, with a top speed around 40+ knots, thanks to its sporty design and powerful engines. The Astondoa 40 cruises at about 25-30 knots, making the Pershing a better choice if speed and thrill are your priority.

How many people can each boat accommodate?

The Pershing 46 can carry up to 10 passengers, while the Astondoa 40 accommodates a maximum of 9. Both are perfect for small groups, families, or couples wanting an intimate experience on the water.

What is the price difference between Pershing 46 and Astondoa 40?

The Astondoa 40 has set prices starting from €749 for 2 hours up to €2,299 for 8 hours, including skipper, drinks, and VAT. The Pershing 46 is priced on request via WhatsApp, reflecting its premium sport-yacht status.

Where do these boats depart from in Marbella?

Both the Pershing 46 and Astondoa 40 depart from Puerto Banús, the famous marina in Marbella. This gives you immediate access to the Costa del Sol coastline and landmarks like La Concha mountain.

What is included in the charter for both boats?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, safety equipment, Spanish IVA (21%), and complimentary drinks (water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava) plus light snacks. No hidden costs.

Which boat is better for a party or celebration?

The Pershing 46, with its sleek design and higher speed, adds a wow factor for celebrations. The Astondoa 40 offers a more relaxed, spacious flybridge, ideal for socialising with drinks and music. Both are excellent for parties.

Can I visit Cala del Faro or Cabopino with either boat?

Yes, both boats can easily reach Cala del Faro, Cabopino, and even Estepona. The Pershing 46’s speed lets you cover more distance quickly, while the Astondoa 40 offers a comfortable cruise to these spots.

How do I book the Pershing 46 or Astondoa 40?

For the Astondoa 40, you can book directly via our website with fixed pricing. For the Pershing 46, contact us on WhatsApp for a custom quote. Both require a deposit to secure your date.
